build_urls: build all Django URLs from resolver using project, task, and annotation IDs for testing
restore_objects: restore project, task, and annotation objects with fixed IDs for endpoint tests
check_urls: check HTTP method status codes against expected values for each Django URL
run: run endpoint tests by building URLs and checking HTTP method responses for a given user role
test_urls_mismatch_with_registered: test that registered Django URLs match the expected all_urls.json reference file
